reconcile.note: Keil & Delitzsch treat 1 Chronicles' Levitical list as an independent, partly corrupted document, so Aijalon's differing tribe reflects transmission drift, not disagreement.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells' Skeptic's Annotated Bible lists Aijalon under Dan in Joshua 21 but under Ephraim in 1 Chronicles 6, naming different tribes for the same city.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.
